metadata.name: Pedestrian Steps Out Before Intersection
metadata.description: A pedestrian on the right kerb, about 62 m ahead of the start, steps across the ego's lane before the intersection. Euro NCAP CPNA 2026 style: the ego starts at and holds ego_speed_kmh; once the ego is within 60 m, the runner holds the pedestrian back and then lets them walk so they reach the middle of the ego's lane (-44.3, -73.61) together with the ego, shifted by arrival_offset_s (±0.5 s at walking speed ≈ the 10–90% impact locations), so the conflict is the same at any test speed. Start spawn 203 is in the same lane as spawn 1, 28 m further back; pedestrian position derived from spawn 12 (4.5 m right of the lane). Verify on CARLA.

events.description: ped_01 steps off the right kerb into the road as the ego approaches

ego_speed_kmh.description: Ego test speed: the ego starts at this speed and is held to it (Euro NCAP CPNA/CPFA 2026: 10–60 km/h in 10 km/h steps).

arrival_offset_s.description: When the pedestrian reaches the middle of the ego lane compared with the ego: 0 = together (Euro NCAP 50% impact), positive = later (near side of the car), negative = earlier (far side); ±0.5 s at walking speed ≈ 10% / 90%.

pedestrian_speed_ms.description: Crossing speed: 1.4 m/s = Euro NCAP 5 km/h walking (CPNA), 2.2 m/s = 8 km/h running (CPFA).
